featured_reviews.name: CS Pravin Navamoney
featured_reviews.review_text:
My car refused to start after my summer trip, I sensed battery issue and made a google search for 'Car Jump Start near me'. The top option having 330 plus 5 star review showed as Janta Batteries.
I called on the number and Mr. Asif came down to my apartment with his testing kit, meter and spare battery. After making necessary checks it was confirmed that my existing battery was dead.
On installing the spare battery, the Car started instantly. Janta Batteries is the official dealer of Exide and Amaron. Mr. Asif briefed me about the new battery specification suited for my car and the cost. I got a new battery installed within 2 hours of my initial call.
Super fast and transparent service.

featured_reviews.name: Santosh Kargutkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today I got my car battery replaced from Janata Battery Shop at Vikhroli, and I must say the experience was outstanding.

Just a day earlier, I had received a much higher quotation from the authorized service center, but Mr. Aasif and his team guided me very honestly. They did not push me to buy anything unnecessary. Instead, they carefully checked my car, explained the actual requirement, and suggested the best suitable battery at a very reasonable and competitive price.

What I truly appreciate is their transparency, technical knowledge, and customer-first approach. In today’s time, finding such honest service providers is rare. The entire process was smooth, quick, and professional.

This is not my first experience with them — their service has always been consistently excellent.

Thank you, Mr. Aasif and team, for your genuine guidance and great service. Highly recommended to anyone looking for trustworthy battery solutions in Vikhroli!

I am very happy with the service provided by him.
